mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, name, type, category, file_size, file_path, uploader, downloads, status, description
mapper.select: SELECT FROM biz_resource ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.name, r.type, r.category, r.file_size, r.file_path, r.uploader, r.downloads, r.status, r.description FROM biz_resource r INNER JOIN biz_lesson_resource lr ON lr.resource_id = r.id INNER JOIN biz_lesson l ON lr.lesson_id = l.id WHERE l.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY l.sort ASC, lr.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_resource (name, type, category, file_size, file_path, uploader, downloads, status, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{category}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{uploader}, #{downloads}, #{status}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
